attr.title: Z3R-Beta: A Link to the Past Redux
attr.desc: An ARM64 RG35XXX-H / KNULLI port of Z3R-Beta, a C reimplementation of A Link to the Past with widescreen, HUD, settings, and randomizer features. Requires player-generated game data.
attr.inst: Generate zelda3_assets.dat on a PC from your own game copy with Redux dialogue enabled, then copy it into the z3r-beta folder.
